messages:
Anya Rao: Hey team — uploaded a fresh mock for the Playground chat UI. Focus areas: streaming text layout, stop / regenerate affordance, token counter placement, and how the prompt library shows suggestions during streaming. Screenshot + prototype link: https://figma.redwood/example-playground-ux (mock-3) Miguel Santos: Looking good overall. Quick q: do we want the token counter to be live while streaming or update only after generation finishes? :thinking_face: Anya Rao: Thinking live but lower-priority visual weight. Small and muted in the corner so it doesn't compete with the stream. It should increment but avoid janky layout shifts. Shilpa Patel: Agree on muted. Also keyboard users need a predictable focus order — stop/regenerate buttons should be tabbable and have clear aria-labels. Suggest `aria-pressed` state for toggle style. Dave Kim: UX nit on microcopy: current button says "Stop" and secondary says "Regenerate". Could we try "Stop" + "Try again"? "Regenerate" reads too technical for some users. Olivia Chen: +1 to "Try again". For accessibility, add visually-hidden text for screen reader: e.g., "Stop generation, partial output will remain" when hovering or focusing. Anya Rao: Nice. Also note design constraint: when streaming we want partial messages to be selectable/copyable. That means avoid overlay loading indicators that block text selection. Miguel Santos: For the streaming area I suggest an `aria-live` region with polite announcements for each chunk summary, not every token. Prototype snippet: ```
``` Shilpa Patel: Minor: role="log" may cause screen readers to jump; maybe `role="status"` for infrequent updates and `aria-atomic` true for whole-message updates. We'll test both. Dave Kim: Token counter placement: option A = bottom-right overlay (muted), option B = left of input line as inline label. I prefer overlay to avoid changing input layout during streaming. Olivia Chen: Overlay needs contrast and non-interference with text selection. Use 12px semi-bold, rgba background with 0.7 and rounded corners. Also include `title` attribute for hover to explain what it measures. Anya Rao: On prompt library: when user clicks a suggestion during streaming, should we interrupt and start new gen or queue? Proposed: clicking replaces the current prompt and opens a confirm quick action: "Replace and run" / "Queue". Miguel Santos: Could we add a tiny toast: "This will stop current generation" to avoid accidental clicks? :eyes: Anya Rao: Yes. Toast copy: "Replacing prompt will stop current generation — replace and run?" Two CTAs: Replace & Run / Cancel. Shilpa Patel: Accessibility: ensure toast is reachable via keyboard and announced. Use role="alertdialog" with focus trap for confirmation. design-bot: Deployed mock v3 to staging with microcopy tweaks (Stop -> Stop, Regenerate -> Try again) and overlay token counter. View at https://staging.redwood/playground/v3 Dave Kim: Quick visual suggestion: add subtle shimmer only on trailing token while streaming to indicate "live" — low contrast animation to avoid motion sickness. Olivia Chen: For color tokens and contrast checks, sending a11y palette tests in next message. Also will run keyboard-only flows tomorrow and post results. Anya Rao: Thanks all — action items: Shilpa to test a11y variants, Miguel to prototype overlay token counter behavior, Olivia to run keyboard tests, Dave to mock the shimmer, I'll update Figma copy and confirmation flow. Back here for follow-up in ~24 hours. :thumbsup:
